intended_rationale: Applicable ship is missing a rudder load-absorbing arrangement.

source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: For ice classes IA and IA Super, due regard shall be paid to the large loads that arise when the rudder is forced out of the midship position when sailing astern in ice or into ice ridges. Suitable arrangements such as rudder stoppers shall be installed to absorb such loads.
